title: Fixed Block Memory Pool
shortDescription: Allocate and free fixed-size blocks without dynamic memory.

objectives: Allocate and free fixed-size blocks without dynamic memory

hints.nudge: How can the allocator tell a valid block start from an interior address?
hints.approach: Keep allocation state separate from address calculation. For freeing, reason about pool bounds, block alignment, and whether that block is currently allocated.

templates.notes: Track block ownership with fixed metadata; do not call malloc/free.

visibleCases.name: allocate all blocks
visibleCases.displayExpect:
ptrs[0], ptrs[1], ptrs[2], ptrs[3] are non-NULL and pairwise distinct
pool_available(&pool) = 0

visibleCases.name: free and reuse
visibleCases.displayExpect:
a != NULL
b != NULL
c = b
pool_available(&pool) = 2

hiddenCases.name: invalid free ignored
hiddenCases.displayInput: free stack pointer and misaligned pool pointer
hiddenCases.explanation: Only exact block starts from this pool can be freed.

hiddenCases.name: double free safe
hiddenCases.explanation: Double free must not corrupt pool state.
